newsitem.title: UK: European bunkers firmer in good demand.
newsitem.headline: European bunkers firmer in good demand.

text.p: European bunker fuel prices firmed on Wednesday, supported by reasonably good demand, tight supplies and the generally firmer tone in world oil markets, traders said.
Traders said supplies at most ARA ports were tight.

Rotterdam 380 cst bunkers were offered in a firmer range around $113/$115 a tonne fob, with traders reporting good demand for product. MDO and gas oil also made good gains in line with stronger ARA spot markets but traders said offers were scarce.
"A lot of the major suppliers simply aren't offering," one trader said.
Traders expected prices to continue rising, with most suppliers sold out, leaving few players to cap the market.
Hamburg activity was thin. 380 cst fuel oil was offered firmer in the $116-18 a tonne range.
Mediterranean business was sluggish, but despite slack buying interest prices edged higher with crude.
The Durban bunker market still suffered from a shortage of product. One refinery undergoing maintenance was expected to be back by the end of the week, relieving supply difficulties.
Recently strong Fujairah bunkers showed some signs of easing with supportive demand beginning to tail off.
